description: This file contains implementation of WAN manager data structures, configuration, and interface management functions, including mutex locking for thread safety, virtual interface handling, and configuration initialization.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetConfigData_locked
methods.description: Locks mutex and returns pointer to current WAN manager configuration data.

methods.name: WanMgrDml_GetConfigData_release
methods.description: Releases mutex lock on WAN manager configuration data.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetConfigData_Default
methods.description: Initializes WAN manager configuration data with default values.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetIfaceGroup_Default
methods.description: Sets default values for interface group.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetIfaceCtrl_Default
methods.description: Sets default values for interface control data.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetMapCtrl_Default
methods.description: Sets default values for map domain control.

methods.name: WanMgr_IfaceCtrl_Delete
methods.description: Deletes interface control data and frees memory.

methods.name: WanMgr_Group_Configure
methods.description: Initializes WAN interface groups and reads configuration from PSM.

methods.name: WanMgr_VirtIfConfVLAN
methods.description: Configures VLAN entries for a virtual interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_WanIfaceConfInit
methods.description: Initializes WAN interface configurations, including virtual interfaces.

methods.name: WanMgr_WanDataInit
methods.description: Initializes WAN data structures and mutex.

methods.name: WanMgr_WanConfigInit
methods.description: Initializes WAN configuration, interface data, and groups.

methods.name: WanMgr_IfaceData_GetTotalWanIface
methods.description: Returns total number of WAN interfaces with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetIfaceData_locked
methods.description: Returns pointer to interface data at given index with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_getVirtualIface_locked
methods.description: Returns virtual interface by base index and virtual interface index with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_getVlanIface_locked
methods.description: Returns VLAN interface by base index, virtual interface index, and VLAN ID with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_VlanIfaceMutex_release
methods.description: Releases mutex lock for VLAN interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_getVirtualMarking_locked
methods.description: Returns virtual marking by base index, virtual interface index, and marking ID with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_VirtMarkingMutex_release
methods.description: Releases mutex lock for virtual marking.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetIfaceDataByName_locked
methods.description: Returns interface data by name with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetVirtualIfaceByName_locked
methods.description: Returns virtual interface by name with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetVIfByName_VISM_running_locked
methods.description: Returns virtual interface with active VISM by name with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_AddVirtVlanIfToList
methods.description: Adds VLAN interface to list.

methods.name: WanMgr_getVirtVlanIfById
methods.description: Finds VLAN interface by ID.

methods.name: WanMgr_AddVirtMarkingToList
methods.description: Adds virtual marking to list.

methods.name: WanMgr_getVirtMakingById
methods.description: Finds virtual marking by ID.

methods.name: WanMgr_AddVirtualToList
methods.description: Adds virtual interface to list.

methods.name: WanMgr_getVirtualIfaceById
methods.description: Finds virtual interface by ID.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetIfaceAliasNameByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves interface alias name by index.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetIfaceIndexByAliasName
methods.description: Retrieves interface index by alias name.

methods.name: WanMgrDml_GetIfaceData_release
methods.description: Unlocks mutex for interface data.

methods.name: WanMgr_VirtualIfaceData_release
methods.description: Unlocks mutex for virtual interface data.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetTotalNoOfGroups
methods.description: Returns total number of interface groups.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetIfaceGroup_locked
methods.description: Returns interface group by index with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgrDml_GetIfaceGroup_release
methods.description: Unlocks mutex for interface group.

methods.name: WanMgr_IfaceData_Init
methods.description: Initializes interface data structure.

methods.name: WanMgr_VirtIface_Init
methods.description: Initializes virtual interface data structure.

methods.name: WanMgr_Remote_IfaceData_Update
methods.description: Updates remote interface data and adds to group.

methods.name: WanMgr_Data_Init
methods.description: Initializes main WAN manager data structures and mutexes.

methods.name: WanMgr_Data_Delete
methods.description: Deletes WAN manager data and destroys mutex.

methods.name: WanMgr_Remote_IfaceData_configure
methods.description: Configures remote interface data, adds virtual interfaces.

methods.name: WanMgr_UpdatePrevData
methods.description: Updates previous WAN data, including config and interface status.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetVirtIfDataByAlias_locked
methods.description: Finds virtual interface by alias with mutex lock.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetActiveVirtIfData_locked
methods.description: Returns active virtual interface with mutex lock.
